'''Adran Blake''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Blake worked as a cook in the [[Space Monkey Café]], a bar that was located in the [[platform city]] of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He assisted the bar's manager, [[Chelsey Grimes]], in his duties. He was also known to be quite grumpy.
